name: main-branch-owner-loop
description: Use when the operator asks Codex to run Main Branch daily owner-loop work from a business repo: start/status/setup/update/doctor, think/codify, end/checkpoint/save, validate, or workflow discovery. Starts from deterministic mb facts and asks before durable writes, provider mutations, publishing, spend, customer contact, or checkpoints.
